tasks_output.raw: Female, 42, 152 lbs, 5'0", no allergies. Diagnosed with anxiety (2005), post-hysterectomy (2023) for uterine mass, and has a meningioma (potential surgery 2026-2028). Medications: hydrochloroquine 200mg 2x daily, Yogaraj Guggulu, kaishore guggulu daily for hand swelling/pain; B12 1x/month for low B12; Vit D 6000iu daily for low Vit D; Sertraline 50mg daily for depression. Flagged biomarkers: high Iron 170 mcg/dL, Ferritin 153.6 ng/mL, AST:ALT Ratio 3.25, Total Protein 8.1 g/dL, Iron Saturation 69%, HbA1c 5.6%, LDL:HDL Ratio 2.38, EAG 114.02 mg/dL, Triglyceride:HDL Ratio 1.68, VLDL 16.8 mg/dL, LDL Cholesterol 119.2 mg/dL, Total Cholesterol:HDL Ratio 3.71, DHEA-S 231 mcg/dL; low Calcium 8.7 mg/dL, Bilirubin 0.23 mg/dL, 25-(OH) Vit D 31.2 ng/mL, UIBC 78 mcg/dL, LDL-C:ApoB Ratio 1.26. Symptoms: chronic pain, frequent headaches/migraines, skin issues, diarrhea, snoring, trouble falling/staying asleep, 1x night wake/urination, wakes refreshed. Work stress high (8/10). Lifestyle: occasional alcohol/cannabis, no exercise, limited sun (2 days/week, 30 min/day). Dental: 2 mercury fillings. Childhood: antibiotics, high sugar diet. Family history: cancer, heart attack, osteoporosis, anxiety, high blood pressure. No mold/chemical exposures. Uses functional, ayurveda, TCM, homeopathy, hanyak approaches. Has pets.
